name: @fabricator-ui/demos
description: Commands for the demos. Run one from the repository root with `bun run demo <command>`.

scripts.check: turbo run typecheck format:check test --filter="./demos/*" --cwd=.. && bun run test && bun run --cwd react-native typecheck
scripts.react-native:ios: bun install --cwd react-native && bun run --cwd react-native ios
scripts.react-native:ipad: bun install --cwd react-native && bun run --cwd react-native ipad
scripts.react-native:android: bun install --cwd react-native && bun run --cwd react-native android
